words: Eye pass 3 (lid band and crease color) failed its gate: face-on readers could not tell it from pass 2 at lineup size (run 1 tied, run 2 pass 2 above pass 3), so the pass 2 eye stays in the scene of record luceras-final/final/scene.blend. Motion carriage, stance pitch, f28-f33 root heights and 8-frame transitions are now baked into the clips (worst pose difference 0.0019 mm against render time). Sprite scale keeps the 192 px rest-body rule, so 283.30 px/m (torso about 5 percent smaller on screen than pass 2); overridable by Nick.
